query: query CheckRepository($owner: String!, $name: String!, $updated: String!, $closed: String!) { repository(owner: $owner, name: $name) { nameWithOwner diskUsage issues(states: OPEN) { totalCount } pullRequests(states: OPEN) { totalCount } } updated: search(query: $updated, type: ISSUE_ADVANCED, first: 0) { issueCount } closed: search(query: $closed, type: ISSUE_ADVANCED, first: 0) { issueCount } rateLimit { cost limit used remaining resetAt } }
